title: Lava Dogs host scout sniper indoctrination course
description: U.S. Marine Corps infantrymen particpate in a scout sniper indoctrination course, Marine Corps Base Hawaii, April 11, 2018. The overall goal of the course is to familiarize students with the main aspects of sniper skills so that when they go to the Scout Sniper Basic School, they will continue to improve and successfully complete it. (U.S. Marine Corps video by Sgt. Zachary Orr)
